cohort: 946 patients undergoing various surgical procedures at Tibebe Ghion Specialized Teaching Hospital, Ethiopia, from August 2019 to December 2019 (61 excluded due to missing data).
finding: Urology and general surgery, neurosurgery, orthopedic surgery, emergency surgery, and trauma were associated with a higher risk of perioperative mortality at 24h and 48h compared to cesarean section delivery.
